text: Choose one scent (lavender/cedar/bergamot - anything) and start using it regularly when you reach a blissful state at the end of yoga practice, or, simply, when you feel very good, calm, and relaxed. In this state, apply a drop to your wrist, take 7 slow breaths, enjoying this scent. After 10–14 days your brain will associate the aroma with relaxation, and you get the simplest opportunity to quickly switch from difficult states into the resourceful state of silence and bliss. This is what psychology calls an "anchor".
